title: Biome vs ESLint: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Biome vs ESLint: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

- Throughput: Biome's Rust core offers significantly higher parsing and analysis speeds.
- Latency: Biome's parallel processing minimizes build times and CI delays.
- Consistency: Biome's integrated formatter/linter reduces config drift.
- Failure Modes: ESLint's plugin ecosystem can introduce complex dependency issues; Biome is more self-contained.
- Operational Overhead: Biome's single binary simplifies setup and maintenance.

Recommendation: For production environments demanding speed and reliability, Biome's architecture is superior.
